entities.summary: Xerxes, a notable figure in the history of Greece, associated with Classical Athens and the Persian Wars (499 BCE–449 BCE). Preceded by Ionian Revolt. Their legacy influenced Battle of Marathon — Athenian victory over Persian invasion force and Battle of Thermopylae — Leonidas and 300 Spartans' last stand.
